# Abokor Tech

> The official portfolio of Abokor Keyse, a Full-Stack Developer and AI Automation Specialist based in Hargeisa, Somaliland. The site is available in Somali and English.

Abokor builds web applications and business systems, cloud solutions, ERP/CRM platforms, n8n and AI automations, and user interfaces.

## Main pages

- [Portfolio](https://abokor.shop/): About, services, skills, projects, experience, and contact information.
- [Curriculum Vitae](https://abokor.shop/cv.html): Education, experience, skills, and contact details.
- [n8n Automation](https://abokor.shop/n8n-automation): Automation services and information.
- [Privacy Policy](https://abokor.shop/privacy): Privacy and data-handling information.
- [Terms of Service](https://abokor.shop/terms): Service terms.
- [Sitemap](https://abokor.shop/sitemap.xml): Canonical site URLs.

## Selected projects

- School Management System: School administration with student, teacher, and admin tools.
- AgentWorks AI: AI-assisted customer support and booking automation.
- BloodSave: Blood donor and hospital coordination platform.
- SO! Gasho ISP CRM: Subscriber, billing, and ISP management system.
- Karti POS: Point-of-sale and inventory management.
- Hospital Management System: Patient, pharmacy, appointment, and billing management.
